name: Cannoli
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Prepare the cannoli shells if you are making them yourself.
Combine the ricotta and sugar. Fold in the whipped cream and chocolate chips.
Fill shells with the ricotta mixture. A piping bag works well here.
Cool cannoli in the fridge before serving.

culture.text: Cannoli are Sicilian pastries consisting of a tube-shaped shell of fried pastry dough, filled with a sweet and creamy filling containing ricotta cheese. Their size ranges from 9 to 20 centimetres. In mainland Italy, the food is commonly known as cannolo siciliano.
